channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que vai aceitar resultado das urnas e que TSE será imparcial
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-DF), a presidential candidate, stated he will accept the October election results and expressed confidence in the impartiality of the TSE, despite previously raising concerns about electronic voting machine security. He emphasized that his stance seeks only greater security and transparency in the electoral system, not an attack on the machines, and retracted a prior claim about Smartmatic’s involvement in Brazilian elections. He also criticized the U.S. visa denials for two officials, suggesting it implies concealment and undermines trust in the process.

item.title: Celina Leão confirma que Michelle não teve condições de ir à convenção do PL no DF
item.description: The governor of the Federal District and re-election candidate, Celina Leão (PP), confirmed that former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro was unable to attend the PL party convention in the DF due to health conditions. The PL convention is currently taking place in Brasília. Michelle Bolsonaro's absence was attributed to health reasons, not political decisions.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro confirma candidatura ao Senado pelo DF em carta lida na convenção do PL
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro confirmed her candidacy for the Senate from the Federal District during the PL's regional convention in Brasília, although she did not attend in person due to a migraine attack. The announcement was made through a letter read at the event. Her candidacy strengthens the PL's strategy to maintain Bolsonarist influence in the country's political center.

item.title: Em convenção do PL-DF, Valdemar faz coro com números de Michelle e Bia Kicis
item.description: During the PL convention in the Federal District, national party president Valdemar Costa Neto led a chant with the ballot numbers of candidates Michelle Bolsonaro and Bia Kicis, encouraging voting before the legally permitted campaign period. The event officially nominated the two as Senate candidates and endorsed Celina Leão’s gubernatorial bid, with Flávio Bolsonaro in attendance. Michelle Bolsonaro, despite being discharged after a migraine hospitalization, did not attend the convention.

item.title: Por que a vitória de Tarcísio no 1º turno pode ser a “pedra no sapato” para Lula
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas' lead in São Paulo gubernatorial polls — with advantages of up to 15 points over Fernando Haddad — poses a significant threat to Lula's 2026 re-election bid, given the state's electoral weight. Federal government approval in São Paulo is deeply weakened, with 59% disapproval and 51.4% negative evaluation, increasing PT's vulnerability if the state-level ally base is not mobilized. A first-round victory for Tarcísio could demobilize the governing coalition precisely when Lula needs it most in Brazil's largest electoral college.

item.title: Sem presença de Michelle, PL oficializa candidatura da ex-primeira-dama ao Senado
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) officially confirmed the candidacies of Michelle Bolsonaro and Bia Kicis for the Senate in the Federal District, despite Michelle's absence from the event due to hospitalization for persistent migraines. Her brother, Diego Torres, read a speech written by her, reaffirming her commitment to the campaign despite her physical absence. The ticket is described as 'pure-blood' since both are from the PL, and Michelle remains the favorite in opinion polls in the DF.

item.title: Flávio deseja boa recuperação a Michelle e fala em resgatar o país
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro attended the PL convention in Brasília, wished Michelle Bolsonaro a swift recovery, and emphasized unity to 'rescue Brazil'. He announced Michelle and Bia Kicis will run for Senate in the DF, while Celina Leão seeks re-election as governor with PL support. The event marked their first public appearance together since their June rift, reconciled after Flávio's social media apology.

item.title: Flávio diz que "diferente de 2022", TSE será "imparcial" nesta eleição
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he will accept the 2026 election results, asserting that the TSE will be impartial this time, unlike in 2022 when Alexandre de Moraes presided over the court. He argued that the current TSE president, Kassio Nunes Marques—appointed by Jair Bolsonaro—will ensure greater security and transparency in the electoral process.

item.title: Michelle envia carta à convenção do PL e fala em “caminhar” com Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro sent a letter to the PL convention in Brasília, read by her brother, stating that she and Flávio Bolsonaro will 'walk together' to defeat what she calls an 'audacious evil'. She mentioned Flávio twice, reinforcing the DF majority ticket and Jair Bolsonaro’s decision to support him. Although discharged from hospital, she did not attend the event, where the PL officially nominated her and Bia Kicis for the DF Senate race and endorsed Celina Leão’s re-election.

item.title: “Meu marido escolheu Flávio e vamos caminhar juntos”, diz Michelle em carta
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro was confirmed as the PL's Senate candidate for the Federal District, but did not attend the convention due to hospitalization for migraines. In a letter read by her brother, she said her husband, Jair Bolsonaro, had chosen to support Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and that they would walk together in the campaign.

item.title: “Meu marido escolheu Flávio e vamos caminhar juntos", diz Michelle em carta. Leia
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, hospitalized due to migraine crises, sent a letter to the PL convention in the Federal District stating that her husband, Jair Bolsonaro, chose Flávio Bolsonaro as the presidential candidate for 2026. She confirmed her Senate candidacy alongside Bia Kicis and emphasized that their political walk aims to restore hope, security, and freedom to the people, asserting that politics affects everyday life, even the price of cooking gas.

item.title: Podemos oficializa 149 candidatos em convenção em SP e sinaliza lançar nome para disputar Senado
item.description: The Podemos party held its state convention in São Paulo and officially nominated 149 candidates for the 2026 elections, including 59 for federal deputy and 90 for state deputy. The party endorsed the re-election of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) and proposed businessman Geraldo Rufino, a former scrap metal collector, as its Senate candidate in coalition with the Cidadania-PSDB federation, which is expected to deliberate on the matter this week.

item.title: Álvaro Dias confirma retorno à política e disputará vaga no Senado
item.description: Former governor and senator Álvaro Dias officially confirmed his return to politics as the MDB candidate for the Federal Senate in the 2026 elections in Rio Grande do Norte. The candidacy was formalized after a period of absence from public life, marking his bid to reclaim a national office. Dias aims to leverage his political experience and local influence to compete in the upcoming state-level race.

item.title: Partidos fecham alianças, Congresso volta do recesso e Copom define juros
item.description: Brazilian parties are finalizing alliances and candidates in electoral conventions ahead of the Electoral Justice deadline next Wednesday, while Congress returns from recess and the Copom meets to set interest rates. These events mark a pivotal moment in the October election race, with direct implications for the country's economic and political agenda.

item.title: Damares diz que Michelle Bolsonaro não irá à convenção do PL em Brasília
item.description: Senator Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF) stated that Michelle Bolsonaro will not attend the PL's district convention in Brasília this Sunday, despite having been discharged from the hospital after treatment for a migraine crisis. This contradicts earlier confirmation by PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto, who had said she would attend. Her absence may affect the mobilization of Bolsonaro's base in the Federal District.

item.title: Lula aposta no tetra contando com gols contra do adversário
item.description: Lula used the World Cup analogy to describe his 2026 re-election bid, stating he has already competed in six 'World Cups' and won three, with another victory meaning a 'tetra'. He is banking on his opponent's weaknesses, comparing them to 'own goals'.

item.title: PL lança Michelle Bolsonaro e Bia Kicis ao Senado pelo DF
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) confirmed the candidacies of Michelle Bolsonaro and federal deputy Bia Kicis for the Senate in the Federal District during its convention in Brasília. The event also formalized support for the re-election of Governor Celina Leão (PP), although Michelle Bolsonaro did not attend due to a hospitalization on Saturday.

item.title: Em evento do PL-DF, Flávio mira no eleitorado feminino e elogia esposa
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) spoke at the PL state convention in the Federal District, praising his wife Fernanda Bolsonaro and making promises to female voters, particularly mothers, including expanding partnerships with municipalities and states for safe daycare and proper nutrition. He also confirmed PL's support for the Senate candidacies of Bia Kicis and Michelle Bolsonaro, expressed support for Celina, and wished Michelle Bolsonaro a speedy recovery.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro anuncia candidatura de Michelle ao Senado mesmo sem presença de ex-primeira-dama
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro announced Michelle Bolsonaro's Senate candidacy for the Federal District, despite her absence due to a migraine crisis. He said she will recover soon and join the PL's majoritarian ticket alongside Bia Kicis, Celina Leão, and himself. Michelle's note, read at the event, confirmed her candidacy and emphasized their joint effort to win the 2026 elections.

item.title: Com Flávio e sem Michelle, convenção do PL-DF confirma candidatura de ex-primeira-dama ao Senado
item.description: Former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro was confirmed as the PL-DF Senate candidate at a convention in Brasília, though she was absent due to hospitalization for a severe headache requiring cranial nerve block anesthesia. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) attended the event and publicly apologized to his stepmother, while Deputy Bia Kicis was also confirmed as a Senate candidate. The party also endorsed the re-election of Celina Leão (PP) for governor of the Federal District.

item.title: PL oficializa candidaturas de Michelle e Bia Kicis ao Senado
item.description: The Liberal Party officially confirmed the candidacies of federal deputy Bia Kicis and former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro for the Senate in the Federal District, announced during the party's convention in Brasília on Sunday, August 2, 2026. Michelle's candidacy had been in doubt following a disagreement with Flávio Bolsonaro over electoral alliances and her leadership in PL Women, but the two reconciled on July 23.

item.title: Flávio declara apoio e deseja melhoras a Michelle em convenção do PL-DF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro expressed support for Michelle Bolsonaro at the PL convention in the Federal District, wishing her a swift recovery after hospitalization due to severe migraines. He endorsed her and Bia Kicis for the Senate, stating they would help 'rescue democracy' and ensure Supreme Court ministers respect the Constitution. Governor Celina Leão confirmed Michelle is in the hospital and only decided to run after consulting with her husband, Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Michelle é anunciada pelo PL para disputar Senado, mas frustra expectativa de ato público com Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro was announced as the PL's pre-candidate for the Senate from the Federal District at a convention in Brasília, but did not attend the event, disappointing expectations for her first public appearance alongside Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. Her absence sparked speculation about her campaign strategy and political visibility.

item.title: “Acho que Lula está ficando gagá”, diz Paulinho da Força
item.description: Federal deputy Paulinho da Força, president of the Solidariedade party, criticized former president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), saying he 'must be going senile' after Lula’s speech at the PT national convention. The remark came in response to Lula’s comments attributing union weakening to the labor reform enacted under the previous government. The incident occurred during the formalization of Lula’s 2026 re-election candidacy.

item.title: Com Flávio, PL confirma Bia e Michelle ao Senado e declara apoio à Celina
item.description: The PL confirmed the candidacies of Bia Kicis and Michelle Bolsonaro for the Senate in the Federal District, while declaring support for Governor Celina Leão's re-election. Michelle Bolsonaro did not attend the convention due to hospitalization for severe headaches, undergoing a cranial nerve block procedure. Her brother, Diego Torres, was named as her substitute.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro atribui responsabilidade pelo tarifaço dos EUA à 'incompetência' do governo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL party's presidential candidate, blamed the United States' tariffs on Brazil on the 'incompetence' and 'aggressions' of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's government.

item.title: Lula faz promessa de investimento em defesa, mas discurso não agrada parte do PT; entenda o motivo
item.description: President Lula delivered a speech at the PT convention defending increased investment in national defense, including rare earths and critical minerals, but party members expressed dissatisfaction with the lack of depth and insufficient focus on concrete policies for women, despite symbolic gestures. He also criticized parliamentary amendments, warned of potential conflict with Congress, and called Bolsonaro a 'traste', contributing to a gradual walkout during his address.

item.title: Campanha de Caiado quer Estado ‘mais magro e musculoso’ para investimentos
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) advocates for a 'lean and muscular' state to improve public service efficiency and create fiscal space for quality investments, without diminishing the state's role in development. His platform, coordinated by Roberto Brant, seeks fiscal consolidation through consensus with the Supreme Court and Congress, avoiding new spending, positions, or public sector expansion, while targeting inefficient parliamentary amendments and supersalaries. Inspired by Michel Temer’s 2016-2018 measures—but without reinstating the spending cap—the goal is to stabilize debt, lower real interest rates, and normalize private sector functioning.

item.title: PCB lança o historiador Carlos Machado como candidato ao governo de SP
item.description: The Brazilian Communist Party (PCB) officially nominated historian Carlos Machado as its candidate for governor of São Paulo in the 2026 elections, with Felipe de Oliveira Queiroz as his running mate. Machado, a native of Franca and state school professor, campaigns on socialism, the re-estatization of public services, and combating racism, machismo, femicide, and LGBTQ+ phobia. The PCB also confirmed Edmilson Costa as its presidential candidate, without nominating anyone for federal or state legislative offices.

item.title: Quem controla a burocracia?
item.description: Governments under Bolsonaro and Lula clashed with the same state bureaucracies not due to ideology, but because of an institutional dynamic: the demand for technical justifications strengthened career civil servants, who use administrative procedures to defend their agencies’ institutional mission without leaks or public confrontations. Their power stems from producing knowledge that legitimizes decisions, not from formal authority to make them. This is not a distortion of democracy, but a natural outcome of societies demanding evidence-based decision-making.

item.title: Michelle recebe alta após ser hospitalizada com enxaqueca no DF
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro was discharged from hospital after treatment for a migraine headache in Brasília and is expected to attend the PL state convention, where her Senate candidacy for the Federal District is expected to be confirmed. Her appearance would mark her first public appearance alongside her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, since their public dispute in June.

item.title: PT oficializa candidatura de Lula ao quarto mandato em convenção em SP
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) officially confirmed Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's candidacy for President of Brazil in the October elections during a convention in São Paulo on Sunday. Lula is seeking a fourth term in office, reinforcing his leadership within the party and building his re-election campaign on the legacy of his previous administrations.

item.title: Lula destaca promessas para mulheres, idosos e militares
item.description: Lula highlighted promises for women, the elderly, and the military during the party convention that formalized his 2026 re-election candidacy. He emphasized creating an assistance program for the elderly focused on quality of life, stressed the need to invest in the defense industry, and reaffirmed national sovereignty over rare earth reserves and energy transition. The full government program will be made public starting August 16.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro é hospitalizada em Brasília para exames
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro was hospitalized in Brasília to investigate a persistent headache lasting over ten days. She missed the Senate candidacy launch of ally Bia Kicis but sent a message of support. On social media, she shared her recovery and thanked followers for their well-wishes.

item.title: Veja fotos da convenção do PL com Flávio e Michelle em Brasília
item.description: The Liberal Party officially nominated Michelle Bolsonaro and Bia Kicis as Senate candidates for the Federal District at a convention held in Brasília on Sunday, August 2, 2026. The event featured Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the party’s presidential candidate, and affirmed PL’s support for the re-election of Governor Celina Leão (PP).

item.title: Podemos define em três dias se Renata Abreu será vice de Flávio ou mantém neutralidade
item.description: Podemos will decide within three days whether Renata Abreu will accept the vice-presidential slot on Flávio Bolsonaro’s ticket or maintain party neutrality in the 2026 presidential race. The National Executive is weighing the invite against the party’s legislative focus and São Paulo-aligned strategy with Tarcísio de Freitas. While Bolsonaro seeks Podemos’ support to boost his TV advertising, insiders suggest Abreu is likely to stay neutral to prioritize her own re-election bid for Congress.

item.title: Lula ignora dívida, diz estar inteiraço e mira Haddad para o futuro
item.description: Lula, aged 80, declared himself 'fit as a fiddle' and officially launched his bid for a fourth term at the PT National Convention, emphasizing his exercise routine and avoiding direct mention of Bolsonaro. He apologized for unfulfilled promises, asked for forgiveness from supporters, and argued that investing in education is cheaper than incarceration, citing comparative cost figures. Despite discussing defense and education, Lula did not mention public debt or public security, even though these are top concerns for Brazilians according to recent polls.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro atribui responsabilidade pelo tarifaço dos EUA à ‘incompetência’ do governo Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL party's presidential candidate, blamed U.S. tariffs on Brazil on the 'incompetence' and 'aggressions' of the Lula government, claiming Lula provoked the sanctions. He denied that his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro influences U.S. decisions, criticized Brazil for 'licking China's boots,' and praised Argentine President Javier Milei for calling Lula a 'prisoner' during Milei's visit to Brazil.

item.title: Horas antes de convenção com Flávio, Michelle informa que segue internada
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro announced she remains hospitalized shortly before the PL party convention in the Federal District, an event expected to feature presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro. She shared the update via social media.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro promete manter Bolsa Família e critica Desenrola em convenção do PL na Paraíba
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL party's presidential candidate, pledged to maintain the Bolsa Família program during the party's convention in Paraíba, stating it is essential for vulnerable families. He criticized the federal government's Desenrola program, arguing it fails to solve Brazilians' debt and merely shifts the problem forward without addressing the structural causes of indebtedness.

item.title: Caiado sobre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro: Brasil está 'sequestrado pelos dois rejeitados'
item.description: Former Goiás governor and presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado claimed Brazil is 'kidnapped' by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, whom he described as the two most rejected figures in national politics.

item.title: Aliado de Ciro, Ivo Gomes afirma que Cid é manipulado por Camilo Santana: 'Não estou o conhecendo mais '
item.description: Former Sobral mayor Ivo Gomes said he is 'no longer knowing' his brother, Senator Cid Gomes (PSB), after the latter announced support for re-election on a Workers' Party ticket, accusing him of being manipulated by Camilo Santana. Ivo declared his support for Ciro Gomes (PSDB) for the Ceará governorship and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) for the presidency, criticizing Cid's alliance with Governor Elmano de Freitas (PT) as a personal betrayal given the longstanding feud between the Ferreira Gomes and Rodrigues families in Sobral.

item.title: Ao vivo: PL realiza convenção em Brasília
item.description: The PL held a convention in Brasília to officially nominate Michelle Bolsonaro and Bia Kicis for the Federal District Senate race, while also declaring support for Governor Celina Leão’s (PP) re-election bid. The event featured Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the party’s presidential candidate, highlighting the family-led political alliance ahead of the October elections.

item.title: Michelle segue internada às vésperas de convenção do PL no DF
item.description: Former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) remains hospitalized in Brasília after undergoing a medical procedure involving cranial and pericranial nerve block anesthesia to treat persistent headaches. She was seen in a photo posted from her hospital bed on Saturday, ahead of the PL party convention in the Federal District. Her team confirmed the treatment is necessary due to the ongoing nature of her headaches.

item.title: Michelle segue internada e coloca em dúvida convenção com Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro remains hospitalized after undergoing a cranial and pericranial nerve block procedure due to persistent headache. Her attendance at the PL regional convention in Brasília, scheduled for 5 p.m. this Sunday, remains uncertain pending further medical updates.

item.title: Mulheres vão às ruas pela votação do PL da Misoginia
item.description: The Levante Mulheres Vivas is mobilizing across multiple Brazilian cities this Sunday to demand approval of Bill 896/2023, the Misogyny Bill, which criminalizes hate-motivated acts against women and has already passed the Senate. Protests are taking place in Belo Horizonte, Brasília, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and other locations, urging the Chamber of Deputies to vote on the bill under urgency regime. The proposal establishes prison sentences of two to five years for misogyny-related crimes and adds gender as an aggravating factor in insults, following a 10% rise in femicides in São Paulo during the first half of 2026.

item.title: Cefaleia: Michelle Bolsonaro passa por procedimento de bloqueio anestésico
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro remains hospitalized and underwent an anesthetic block of cranial and pericranial nerves to treat persistent headaches. Her team stated the procedure was due to recurring migraines, with no discharge date yet announced. She was expected to attend the PL party convention in the Federal District to launch her Senate campaign, but her attendance remains unconfirmed.

item.title: PL diz que sites falsos pedem doações com nome de Flávio
item.description: The PL warned that three fake websites are using Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's name to fraudulently solicit donations, posing as official campaign channels. The party urged supporters to avoid suspicious links and file police reports if they already donated, emphasizing that the only legitimate donation site is www.contribua.com.br/flaviopresidente.

item.title: Os interesses que aproximam Lula e o governador interino do Rio de Janeiro
item.description: Rio de Janeiro's interim governor, Ricardo Couto, is maintaining a political rapprochement with President Lula, characterized by mutual gestures of support and coinciding with STF investigations targeting Bolsonarism, including Flávio Bolsonaro. This alliance aims to recover the Workers' Party's influence in the state, lost to Bolsonarism in recent years, with Lula having recently visited Rio and received emotional displays of support from Couto. The move is seen as strategic for both: Lula strengthens his Fluminense base for a potential 2026 re-election, while Couto may seek a future STF seat as a quid pro quo.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro publica foto internada em hospital e sua participação em evento com Flávio vira dúvida
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro remains hospitalized in Brasília following an anesthetic procedure to treat migraine crises, raising doubts about her attendance at the PL convention expected to confirm her Senate candidacy. Despite her absence, allies state she confirmed her intention to run, and the event could mark her first public appearance alongside Flávio Bolsonaro since their recent reconciliation after a public feud. Bolsonaro’s defense secured authorization for Michelle’s sister to visit the former president while she is hospitalized.
